Second-longest serving and one of the greatest of all-time.

Congrats to Justice Thomas!


NEWSMAX (@NEWSMAX)

Clarence Thomas this week will reach a major milestone on the U.S. Supreme Court, becoming the second-longest-serving justice in American history.





— https://nitter.net/NEWSMAX/status/2050942940458234201#m

End it, don’t mend it.


SWAG🇺🇸 (@GodEmperorKek2)

Governor what are your thoughts on the H-1B visa and if you ever were president would you end them?



— https://nitter.net/GodEmperorKek2/status/2051076370956996982#m

No amnesty.  Not today, not ever!


Blaise Ingoglia (@GovGoneWild)

EPISODE#2 Amnesty 

Did you know that “The Dignity Act” lets illegal aliens help other illegal aliens qualify for amnesty?

Did you know that President Reagan’s Attorney General Ed Meese admitted the 1986 amnesty was a failure? 

Amnesty for illegal immigrants will only attract MORE illegal immigrants. 

It’s the same promise. 
It’s the same playbook. 
We’re gonna get the same results.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/GovGone

Hakeem wanted ”maximum warfare,” didn’t he?


Remarks (@remarks)

JUST IN: 🇺🇸 President Trump calls for House Republicans to remove Democrat Rep. Hakeem Jeffries from office.







— https://nitter.net/remarks/status/2051079454873555090#m

Was I a kid in the 80s?


SWAG🇺🇸 (@GodEmperorKek2)

Unrelated to baseball, governor do you like the movie Back to the Future?



— https://nitter.net/GodEmperorKek2/status/2051127912162603310#m

Good one.

Another good one from the 70s: Bingo Long Traveling All-Stars and Motor Kings


Don Woods (@DonWoooo)

Bang the Drum Slowly featuring DeNiro before he went nutso.



— https://nitter.net/DonWoooo/status/2050983396235444311#m

Honorable man playing an honorable game.


GOLF.com (@GOLF_com)

Penalty for Cameron Young on the second. 😳

He said that the ball moved slightly forward after he addressed it, but he was unsure if his action caused it to move.

The rules officials determined he caused his ball to move, and he was assessed a one-stroke penalty. He was the only person who saw the ball move, but he still called the rules official over. Gentleman's game. 👏





— https://nitter.net/GOLF_com/status/20509724596970660

Major League.

  



SleeperMLB (@SleeperMLB)

What do you think is the best baseball movie of all time?





— https://nitter.net/SleeperMLB/status/2027182355585069210#m

Florida leads yet again!


Freedom Foundation (@FreedomFdtn)

Florida is showing the rest of the country how beating corrupt unions is done!





— https://nitter.net/FreedomFdtn/status/2051013928130637973#m

Nobody will measure up to CT.  Just a unique figure in American jurisprudence.  And he’s still at the top of his game.


GET TO THE CHOPPA! 🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸 (@deez_nutzurchin)

We're screwed after he's gone.



— https://nitter.net/deez_nutzurchin/status/2051075825705881881#m

It’s a great sequel — but I wish Lou Brown didn’t get sidelined and not having Wesley Snipes hurt it IMO.


Sean Logue (@SeanLogue18)

Governor, any thoughts on Major League 2?



— https://nitter.net/SeanLogue18/status/2051071265373405333#m

Yes, along with Mr. Baseball and For the Love of the Game.


Kyle Lamb (@kylamb8)

Rookie of the Year deserves honorable mention



— https://nitter.net/kylamb8/status/2051062436942188848#m

All are good — I’d rank Sandlot higher than them, though.


james fantine (@FantineJames)

Damn. Good list. I would add Rookie of the Year, Soul of the Game and Mr Baseball.  But Sandlot is top tier.



— https://nitter.net/FantineJames/status/2051064837124284629#m

You mean other than playing in the Little League World Series?


DrPutt4Doh (@putt4_doh)

Sounds like a guy who never played baseball as a kid. Or chased lifeguards like Wendy Peffercorn



— https://nitter.net/putt4_doh/status/2051068768999154020#m

I like Sandlot but I’d rank it behind:

Major League, the Natural, Field of Dreams, Bull Durham, Damn Yankees, Moneyball, Pride of the Yankees, 61*, 42, Eight Men Out, Bad News Bears


Florida Man - World's Superhero (@danmmeyer)

Ron, gotta disagree here. Sandlot is the best baseball movie



— https://nitter.net/danmmeyer/status/2051047663492030537#m
